patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section uses large, abstract, hand-drawn-style flower illustrations to frame and balance the central text content.
Vibrant, saturated primary colors (red, blue, yellow, pink) are used for abstract graphic elements, contrasting against a muted, off-white background.
A sophisticated serif font is used for prominent headings and display text, paired with a clean, modern sans-serif for body copy and smaller labels.
Content sections and project cards animate into view with a subtle slide-up or fade-in effect as the user scrolls down the page.
A full-width, repeating pattern of colorful, abstract flower illustrations forms a distinctive and playful background for the footer area.

technique_notes: The hero section employs large, organic, hand-drawn-style shapes positioned to create an asymmetrical yet balanced visual composition around the main heading.
Content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where elements slide or fade into the viewport from the bottom, likely orchestrated with JavaScript and CSS keyframes.
Project showcases are presented within realistic device mockups, often rendered with a subtle three-dimensional perspective to add depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual hierarchy, complemented by a clean sans-serif for readable body text and functional elements.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements and card corners, with organic, irregular shapes used for decorative graphic elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and generous, particularly in the hero and between major content sections, creating a calm and uncluttered visual experience.

standout: This site's design is distinctive through its bold and playful use of large, abstract, hand-drawn-style flower illustrations as core visual motifs. These organic shapes, combined with a sophisticated serif typography and a vibrant accent palette, create a highly personal and artistic brand identity that feels unique and memorable, moving beyond typical portfolio templates.
